paragraphs: R' Pedat the Elder. His son was R' Elazar (see above, bar Pada), and he lived a long life. Yuhasin writes in Seder Ha-Kabbalah with Rema's glosses: R' Pedat was Rabbi's colleague, and R' Pedat bar R' Elazar was his grandson. Those who spoke in the name of R' Pedat the Elder or his grandson I shall list shortly.
